about.title: About AROKYA ILLAM
about.subtitle: Building a More Inclusive India
about.description: AROKYA ILLAM CHARITABLE TRUST (AICT) is a public charitable trust working across India to ensure dignity, access, and inclusion for persons with disability.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: To provide healthcare, rehabilitation, education, and social support that improves the quality of life for persons with disability. We envision a society where every person with disability can live with dignity, achieve their potential, and participate fully in community life.

values.title: Our Values
values.subtitle: The principles that guide our work and shape our approach to supporting persons with disability.

compassion.title: Compassion
compassion.description: We approach every individual with empathy, understanding, and genuine care for their unique needs and circumstances.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: We are committed to breaking down barriers and ensuring that all persons with disability have equal access to opportunities.

inclusion.title: Inclusion
inclusion.description: We believe in creating a society where persons with disability are fully included and valued as equal members.

justice.title: Justice
justice.description: We advocate for the rights and dignity of persons with disability, ensuring fair treatment and equal opportunities.

governance.title: Governance & Transparency
governance.subtitle: We maintain the highest standards of governance and transparency in all our operations.
